Common Questions

How do I make a work-from-home desk in my bedroom feel less stressful?

Use a desk mat to define the zone, add an under-desk drawer to hide work gear at 5 PM, and switch your monitor light bar to warm evening lighting after work.

What is the 2-minute end-of-day desk reset habit?

Before logging off, clear mugs, tuck notebooks into your under-desk drawer, coil any loose cables, and write tomorrow's top 3 tasks on your desktop whiteboard.
